name: Windows App Status
description: Checks application status, controls windows, and captures screenshots of a selected application window only on Windows.

commands.title: Check whether an app is open
commands.description: Input a program name, for example Chrome or Notepad. Returns whether a matching process is running, plus its process name, PID, and visible window titles. Accepts a string or an object with a name, program, or app field.

commands.title: Control an application window
commands.description: Open, minimize, maximize, or gracefully close a Windows app. For open, accept a friendly display name (for example Google Chrome), executable name, or path; resolve friendly names through Start Menu shortcuts and registered app metadata. Input: {"action":"open","name":"Google Chrome"}. Other actions target the best-matching visible window.

commands.title: Capture an application window screenshot
commands.description: Save a PNG screenshot of only the requested visible Windows application window, never the desktop or other apps. Input a program name as a string or {"name":"Notepad"}; optional outputPath sets the PNG path. By default saves under Pictures\Windows App Status.
